title: think session is a pure reducer + shell
rationale: Keeps UX logic testable without a terminal; one event per mutation

description: macOS fs.watch on a directory coalesces rename-over saves (vim style) and may report only the temp file name, not idea.md.
resolution: watch.ts re-reads on ANY directory event (content compare filters noise) plus a 1s poll fallback

name: live agent arrivals via reducer arrive input
description: think watches questions.jsonl (tier>=1) and dispatches {type:'arrive'} into the pure session reducer: arrivals go before the first unreached rule question (never ahead of the current one); a full queue bumps the last unreached rule question (stays open for next session) or leaves the arrival for next session. A 'seen' id set prevents re-queuing bumped/pre-existing questions.

name: nested-tui-handoff
description: tend hands an accepted split to a think session: the shell stops its Terminal, awaits an injected ThinkRunner (commands/think.ts startThink with ScreenGuidance), then restarts the Terminal with the same dispatch. Pure reducers (tend.ts, session.ts) never see the handoff; tests drive both on one fakeTerminal.
macOS FSEvents drops fs.watch events for a load-dependent window right after watch() returns; the pollMs:0 rename test in src/watch.test.ts failed ~1 in 10 runs under CPU load.
resolution: Tests rewrite the file until the watcher reports a change (armed() helper) instead of a fixed sleep; product code is covered by the 1s poll fallback.

description: Spinner status line spammed new lines during think's agent wait: think opens the editor split BEFORE the agent phase, so the status line wraps in the half-width pane and \r\x1b[2K only clears the last physical row.
resolution: startStatus takes columns() and cuts each frame below terminal width (spinner.ts fitLine).

title: Dropped herdr split support; tmux/zellij only
rationale: herdr pane split+run path opened a second editor-like pane during tend adopt and added integration surface nobody needed yet; plain TUI is enough, herdr can return later.

title: Answer→line attribution via content hashes (roots blame)
rationale: answer events store lines: 12-hex sha256 of each trimmed non-blank line the save added (changedLines multiset diff); blame matches current idea.md lines by hash, last answer wins. Hashes not text keep invariant 3 (no human prose in JSONL); content not line numbers survives edits elsewhere. Pre-existing answers without lines count as untracked.

description: Full-screen renders (think screen, tend card, flow card) must clamp to terminal rows: frame() writes home+clear then lines; any overflow scrolls the top border off-screen.
resolution: Fold low-priority rows (links, older trail entries, card body tail) so output never exceeds rows; tests assert lines[0] holds the title at a short height.

title: flow keeps only explicit [o] picks
rationale: Preserving the default pick across refreshes made the heading's next suggestion get ignored (flaky test).

description: parseKeys lowercased raw input, so escape sequences leaked letters: arrow up (ESC [ A) became the 'a' key once [a] existed.
resolution: Strip CSI/SS3/Alt escape sequences (ESCAPE_RE in session.ts) before mapping keys; test with ESC [1;5A and ESC O A.
